title: Office Relocation Minimal Downtime Checklist for Addis Firms
excerpt: Friday load Sunday open playbook: IT cutover, phone forwarding, and staff seating plan at new Kazanchis or Sengatera floor.
content:
Runbook owner

Assign one person from IT and one from operations to own the move weekend. Movers follow numbered desk labels and floor plans—see office relocation and Kazanchis office guide.

48 hours before

  • Forward phones and update auto-replies with new address if needed.
  • Print seating chart with desk numbers matching carton labels.
  • Backup servers; photograph patch panels before disconnect.
  • Notify both buildings of freight elevator reservations and after-hours access.

Move weekend sequence

  • Load in reverse unpack order—IT room last in at origin, first out at destination.
  • Keep one “Monday box” per department with cables, keyboards, and snacks.
  • Test internet and access control before announcing staff return.
  • Walk leadership through reception and fire exits before Monday traffic.

Downtime cost in the quote

Office floors often start from 45,000 ETB after survey on the 2026 cost guide. After-hours freight and IT escorts belong as line items—not day-of surprises. BPO and call-center floors: BPO guide · NGO guide.

What movers do not move

Shred confidential paper on site; carry laptops and tokens personally. Confirm insurance for server racks and copiers in the written scope.

Book office move

Survey request · +251982260000

Staff communication

Send employees packing rules Friday: personal items home, labeled desk contents, no loose drawers. Monday morning should be plug-in and login—not hunting cartons in the parking lot.
